en: I can't believe I overlooked this!
What do you mean?

There were only two people in the hangar
at the time the bodies were swapped.
Which means...they were <CLT=cltSTRONG>working together<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Huh? Working together...?

The only two people involved in the swap
were the <CLT=cltSTRONG>victim...and the culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit was operating the camera and the
hydraulic press, while the victim lay inside.

If they switched places while the press
and the camera were stopped...

...then the person who turned the camera and
the press back on was the original victim.

To put it simply, both people operated the
press and camera at different times.

An impossible trick...unless the victim and
culprit agreed to <CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperate beforehand<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

The victim and culprit cooperated?
Is that...even possible?

It sounds bizarre, but perhaps
that was the whole point.

Commit a crime that was so confusing,
even Monokuma would be tricked.
Geez, this culprit's a real jerk.
...So, have you realized whodunnit yet?
<CLT=cltMIND>The culprit of the case...

<CLT=cltMIND>If my detective work hasn't failed
me, the culprit is inside that Exisal...
<CLT=cltMIND>It can only be them.

<CLT=cltMIND>The would-be victim, before the swap,
was clearly Kaito...

If the victim and culprit switched places, then
the victim at the start of the video didn't die.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
No, no, that's not it.

Still, it's pretty ballsy of the victim to
cooperate with the culprit.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Who is in the Exisal?

The apparent victim we saw in the video
was Kaito. Which means...

...Kokichi was operating the hydraulic
press and camera...at first.

If the two of them switched while
the press was stopped...

...then the culprit who started the hydraulic
press again and crushed Kokichi...
...must be <CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

So...the person inside that Exisal
isn't Kokichi...
It has to be Kaito!
Wh-What did you say!?
So the culprit for this case is...

Kaito Momota... That is what the Ultimate
Detective has deduced, right?

Kaito is the culprit? What...? You're
joking, right? You can't be serious...

I don't want to believe it either...but
it's the only way any of this makes sense.

My detective work has led me to the
conclusion that Kaito is the culprit.

...Is that true?
Is Kaito...really in there?

Hey, answer us!
If you really are Kaito, then—
I'm the culprit.
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?

There's just no way that Kaito can
still be alive...
Because I'm the culprit.
W-Wait, you? But didn't you say—
I saw it with my own eyes.

Kokichi drank the antidote that he stole
from Kaito...

There's no doubt Kaito died. And he died
because of my poison arrow.

But you told us you didn't
want to kill Kaito and—

Yes, I never wanted to. I wanted to believe 
that I didn't kill him.

But...the truth speaks differently. In the end,
I was just running away from the facts.
H-Huh? I don't understand...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki, are you...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Trying to protect Kaito?

<CLT=cltMIND>If he's the culprit, you're trying
to help him get away?

There was only one antidote, so it's more 
likely he died from my poison arrow.
This is the truth...

It's not decided yet. I could've still killed
him with the hydraulic press.

Either way, those are the two options.
Monokuma knows the answer, riiight?
...Huh? Are those the only options?
I guess that's how things turned out...

No, that can't be!
The person in that Exisal is—

It's not Kaito! 
I saw Kokichi drink the antidote!

There's no mistake...
Kaito is dead...
I...killed Kaito...

There is absolutely...no doubt.
That's...the truth.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I thought so.
Maki is trying to protect Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>I understand how she feels,
but if Kaito is the culprit...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why did he agree to
Kokichi's plan?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't imagine that Kaito would
do something so selfish...

<CLT=cltMIND>There must be a reason for it.
I truly believe that...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I have to get to the bottom of this
before I can uncover that truth...

But Maki...you don't know for certain
that Kokichi drank the antidote.
...What?

You saw him drink it right in front of you,
but you couldn't confirm he actually did it.
So maybe...there's another possibility.
What...are you talking about?
Impossible... That's...impossible...

There is no other possibility!
I killed Kaito!
